kurz: Scallops need a dry surface and a very hot pan: a golden crust outside, still glassy and sweet inside.
bild_im_kopf: Like a marshmallow over a fire: the outside should caramelise before the inside melts.
was_passiert: The muscle contains a little sugar, so it browns fast and tastes sweet. Wet surfaces slow browning because the water has to evaporate first. Some scallops are treated with salts that bind water: they release water in the pan and barely brown.
warum_wichtig: Scallops are expensive and ruined in a minute. Knowing what matters gets you the crust before the inside turns rubbery.
faustregeln: Buy untreated, so-called dry scallops: they brown far better.
The centre should still be slightly glassy; it keeps cooking on the plate.
schritte: Pull off the small, tough side muscle.
Pat thoroughly dry with kitchen paper and salt only just before frying.
Heat a pan with a little oil until the oil shimmers.
Lay the scallops in with space between them and leave them untouched for about 1.5 to 2 minutes.
Turn, add a knob of butter and take them out after another minute.
